intro: Keerthaneeyamainadhi is one of the popular Christian Telugu song written, tuned by Veturi Sundara Rammoorthy and sung by Telugu Christian Gospel Singer, Song-writer, Philip Gariki and music composed by renowned telugu christian music director, J K Christopher. This live song video by Philip Gariki was released on September 13, 2020 through Philip Sharon YouTube channel.
